fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Murjiʾah separate action from īmān
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Sufyān ath-Thawrī and the imams of Ahl al-Sunnah explained īmān as word and deed; it rises and falls.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** By this, irjāʾ is refuted: īmān is not merely a statement or an inner claim, but comprises belief, word, and action.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah, Kapitel zum Īmān.
